group: Valid inputs – both JsonNode and Config provided

cases.expected: JsonSchema instance whose internal schema node equals the supplied JsonNode and whose config equals the supplied config
cases.description: When a well‑formed JsonNode and a non‑null SchemaValidatorsConfig are supplied, getSchema should create a JsonSchema wrapping the node without throwing any exception.

cases.expected: JsonSchema instance whose internal schema node equals the supplied JsonNode and whose config is null (or default config used internally)
cases.description: The method should accept a null config and fall back to the factory’s default configuration rather than throwing an exception.

cases.expected: IllegalArgumentException (or NullPointerException) indicating that the schema JsonNode cannot be null
cases.description: Passing a null JsonNode is illegal; the method (via newJsonSchema) should raise an exception rather than returning a JsonSchema.

cases.expected: IllegalArgumentException (or NullPointerException) because the schema JsonNode is required
cases.description: Even when config is also null, the missing JsonNode should cause the method to fail fast.

cases.expected: JsonSchema instance that represents an empty schema (no validation rules)
cases.description: An empty JsonNode should still produce a valid JsonSchema object; this verifies that the method does not treat empty objects as invalid.

group: Edge case – malformed JSON node (non‑object root)

cases.expected: JsonSchema instance (factory may accept any JsonNode) or IllegalArgumentException if the implementation validates the root type
cases.description: Testing how the method behaves when the supplied JsonNode is a primitive value rather than an object; some implementations allow it, others reject it.

group: Valid inputs – config with custom settings

cases.expected: JsonSchema instance whose internal schema node equals the supplied JsonNode and whose config has failFast=true and typeLoose=true
cases.description: When a well‑formed JsonNode is supplied together with a non‑default SchemaValidatorsConfig, the factory should propagate the custom settings into the created JsonSchema.

cases.expected: JsonSchema instance representing an array schema with the specified constraints
cases.description: The method should accept a schema that describes an array and return a JsonSchema that mirrors those constraints.

cases.expected: JsonSchema instance whose internal schema node is the boolean true (represents a schema that always validates)
cases.description: JSON Schema draft‑7 permits a boolean value as the whole schema; the factory must handle this case without throwing an exception.

group: Invalid input – jsonNode is a numeric primitive

cases.expected: IllegalArgumentException indicating that the root schema node must be an object or boolean
cases.description: A numeric root is not a valid JSON Schema; the factory should reject it early with an appropriate exception.

cases.expected: JsonSchema instance that stores the supplied JsonNode (including the $ref) without attempting to resolve it at creation time
cases.description: The factory should not resolve $ref during getSchema; it merely wraps the node, allowing later validation to handle reference resolution.

cases.expected: JsonSchema instance whose internal schema node contains the $id, properties, and definitions exactly as supplied
cases.description: Ensures that complex schemas with $id, nested definitions and external $ref are accepted and preserved by the factory.

group: Invalid input – jsonNode is an empty array

cases.expected: IllegalArgumentException because a JSON Schema root cannot be an array
cases.description: An empty JSON array is not a valid schema root; the factory should reject it with a clear exception.

group: Invalid input – jsonNode is a string primitive

cases.expected: IllegalArgumentException indicating that the root schema node must be an object or boolean
cases.description: A JSON string literal is not a valid JSON Schema root; the factory should reject it with an IllegalArgumentException.

group: Invalid input – jsonNode is a JSON null literal

cases.expected: IllegalArgumentException indicating that the schema JsonNode cannot be a JSON null value
cases.description: A JSON null node is not a valid schema root; the method should throw an IllegalArgumentException rather than creating a JsonSchema.
